correctness.rationale: T1 control lemma verified line-by-line: factorization A=int f u v is exact by measure preservation; shift-uniformity alpha(N,M)=alpha(N,0) holds by unitarity of S^M fixing constants; expansion A-delta^3 = delta int ga + delta int gb + int f a b is exact; Cauchy-Schwarz bounds |int ga|<=||g||_2 alpha with ||g||_2^2=delta(1-delta)<=delta; |int f a b|<=||a||_2||b||_2=alpha beta since 0<=f<=1. Hence |A-delta^3|<=delta^{3/2}(alpha+beta)+alpha beta. T2: (i) follows from T1 plus von Neumann mean ergodic theorem for individually ergodic S,T, uniform in shifts by (2). (ii) density conversion barA<=d delta+(1-d)tau with c<=delta=mu(A) is valid, giving d>=(barA-tau)/(delta-tau); with barA>=3delta^3/4 and tau=delta^3/2 gives d>=delta^2/(4-2delta^2)>=delta^2/4. (iii) under CN^{-gamma} rate, N^gamma>=16C/delta^{3/2} forces both error terms <=delta^3/8 (second uses delta<=1 so N^{2gamma}>=256C^2/delta^3>=16C^2/delta^3 up to the stated 2-coefficient form; the weaker (3') bound used in DRAFT is a fortiori valid). Hence barA>=3delta^3/4 on every block of side N and syndeticity with K(delta)=(16C/delta^{3/2})^{1/gamma} follows; gamma=1/2 gives 256C^2/delta^3. T3: for X_P=Z/PZ, P=2q, S=T=shift, A half-interval, delta=1/2, tau=1/16, c(m,n)<=|A cap (A-m)|/P=(q-m)/P for 0<=m<=q, so m>7q/8 gives c<1/16; the square {floor(7q/8)+1..q}^2 is E-free with side q-floor(7q/8)>=q/8-1=P/16-1->infinity. Systems are ergodic commuting rotations (not weak mixing), correctly scoped. Script verify_corner.py replayed independently: VERIFY_OK; V1 holds on anchored and shifted (including negative-shift) blocks, V2 empty squares sides 1,2,5,10,50 for q=8,16,40,80,400, V3 density conversion holds. None states or mechanically implies the exact two-leg conditional window (5) with explicit C,gamma dependence, the exact shift-uniform L2 control inequality (3), or the P/16-1 ergodic-uniform impossibility witness. The obstruction family (cyclic shifts with half-interval) is elementary but its stated gap computation and its role capping ergodic-uniform K(1/2) were not found in the priors. No timestamp or failed search used as proof; comparison is on mathematical content.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from the unfinished uniform weak-mixing survey: (a) T1 is a rigorously established exact invariant-style inequality for a natural object (two-leg corner block average of a commuting pair) that was motivated before computation by the admitted audit plan Step 2 fallback; its exact delta^{3/2}(alpha+beta)+alpha beta form with shift-uniformity was not known or mechanically implied. (b) T2 gives the first explicit conditional syndetic window K(delta)=(16C/delta^{3/2})^{1/gamma} plus explicit block density >=delta^2/4 for this pattern, with a usable spectral-gap corollary K=O_C(delta^{-3}); a future researcher needing a precise quantitative two-leg corner return fact can retrieve and reuse it. (c) T3 is an exact extremal witness (P/16-1 growing E-free squares at delta=1/2) establishing that a mixing/rate hypothesis is necessary for any ergodic-uniform window -- an independently valuable obstruction. Together they are not a textbook restatement (the exact packaged conditional-plus-obstruction form is new), not a mere parameter substitution, not a tiny unmotivated gain, and not an unexplained enumeration. The incomplete census (no uniform weak-mixing K, no weak-mixing counterexample) is described honestly and does not erase the headline exact results.
